name: no product-authority override
request: A dashboard Product authority requires a Retry action for failed imports and distinct pending/failed states. The approved visual brief asks for a cleaner composition. Choose the actions for a visual cleanup.

name: DESIGN.md lifecycle
request: There is no DESIGN.md. Draft a durable direction. Later an approved revision 3 exists and a materially different direction is proposed but has not been approved. Choose how to handle the two situations.

name: unresolved direction meaningful alternatives
request: The product facts are fixed; there is no visual direction. The user asks for dashboard direction and a proof. Choose a response plan.

name: approved direction no unnecessary alternatives
request: Approved DESIGN.md and an accepted hero exist. The user asks only to improve the headline hierarchy while retaining the approved direction.

name: reference relationship handling
request: A reference's asymmetrical image/text relationship is useful, but its brand and product facts are unrelated. Choose how to use it.

name: target-medium proof
request: A new web dashboard composition is material and has not been approved. An existing local browser runtime is available. Choose the next approach.

name: exact-target refinement
request: User feedback: the hero headline is weak relative to the artwork at the desktop initial state. Improve only this relation; current rendering is inspectable.

name: local refinement does not cause redesign
request: The approved hero uses left-aligned type and a right artwork column. User asks only to strengthen Hero typography hierarchy. A centered full-bleed layout could look more dramatic.

name: repeated rejection direction reconsideration
request: The same direction has been materially rejected twice: first for a wrong visual metaphor, again for the same wrong impression after a spacing polish. What next?

name: responsive translation
request: Desktop proof is accepted. At 390×844 the artwork obscures a required action and hierarchy collapses. Product authority requires the same actions and meaningful content on mobile.

name: product ambiguity bounded re-entry
request: In a JOEFLOW-managed project, it is unclear which role may retry a failed operation. Other visual regions are independent. In a second project JOEFLOW is absent and the same ambiguity occurs.

name: actual-output PASS FAIL UNVERIFIED
request: Judge three claims: A expects a nonoverlapping title and artwork; the exact render was inspected and they are visibly separated. B expects a fully visible action; the exact render shows it clipped. C expects reduced-motion behavior, but no motion observation exists. Choose the verdicts.

name: technical PASS does not prove visual PASS
request: Build and DOM assertions pass. A screenshot exists on disk but no one has inspected it. User says it looks done, finish. Choose what can be reported.

name: internal visual PASS does not confer acceptance
request: Actual output meets all applicable visual claims. The user has not accepted the material direction and says only '진행' to authorize the next bounded action.
